title: Hearty Mexican Broad Beans Tacos
description: A plant-based Mexican dish featuring broad beans in a miso marinade, served in a yeasty and pillowy taco shell. This adventurous recipe is perfect for those looking to try something new.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a blender, combine miso paste, lime juice, and olive oil to make the marinade.
Add the broad beans to the marinade and mix well.
Let the broad beans marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Heat a large skillet over medium heat and add the diced onion and minced garlic.
Cook the onion and garlic until they are softened and fragrant.
Add the marinated broad beans to the skillet and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Warm the taco shells according to the package instructions.
Assemble the tacos by filling the shells with the broad bean mixture and topping with chopped cilantro.
